\Unit{The exact conformance candidate}{ecs:candidate}{%
This is a prospective engineering evidence procedure. Its sole scientific
authority is SCI-FRUIT-NORMATIVE-CORE v0.1/r0.2 with the exact digest on this
cover. It adds no numerical method or scientific obligation. Evidence is
assessed per requirement for an immutable candidate, never for an unspecified
implementation name or generic algorithm family.

Define the candidate tuple $\mathcal C$ with every component explicitly bound:
\begin{enumerate}
\item implementation/source identity, revision and exact source-tree digest;
\item build recipe/toolchain/artifact identity and runtime/environment identity;
\item normative-core identity and exact canonical source-inventory digest;
\item method-specific FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD identity, complete record digest and owner-decision binding;
\item exact producer parent route, grouping, scientific identity and generation;
\item separate candidate/accepted/applied model generations and transformation bindings;
\item resolved ordered operation graph and all consequential state generations;
\item absolute iteration, lineage, branch, application and attempt identities;
\item output product role and immutable product generation;
\item evidence generation, with fixture/oracle/comparison and reviewer bindings.
\end{enumerate}
Each identity must resolve to immutable bytes or an exact content-addressed
scientific record. A candidate digest binds the complete tuple, its serialization
convention and referenced objects; changing a component creates a new candidate.
Do not use a filename, process exit or common array shape as an identity proof.

Before numerical evidence, check the method's exact separate owner approval
and required upstream numerical authority. They are absent in this Stage B
packet. Every numerical result here is \texttt{blocked}, explicitly dependency-blocked
by the absent approved method/route, not \texttt{pass}. Document integrity is
reported separately and cannot fill a candidate's numerical fields.

The blank candidate/result template accompanies this specification. Null
fields are unresolved placeholders and are not a partially admitted candidate.
A future assessment may instantiate them only within separately authorized work.
\ReadCore{REQ-001--003, REQ-007, REQ-010, REQ-023.}
}
\Unit{Requirement evidence, results and comparisons}{ecs:evidence}{%
One evidence record binds requirement ID; complete candidate identity;
exact observable; immutable fixture identity/digest; independent oracle or
expected-value construction; preregistered comparison; result; artifact
identities/digests; reviewer/date; and deviation/failure disposition.
The record also retains blocking dependency, applicability premise, affected
claim/scope and any superseded evidence parent. A requirement summary or a
finite output is not evidence that the requirement holds.

Use exactly five result values, independently of evidence-artifact realization:
\begin{description}
\item[pass] The declared applicable requirement is supported for the exact candidate by complete admissible evidence under its preregistered comparison.
\item[fail] Admissible evidence contradicts the applicable requirement or the candidate violates its mandatory record/gate contract; retain the exact discrepancy and scope.
\item[blocked] A named required authority/input/fixture/oracle/comparison dependency prevents assessment; retain exact identity/cause and never count it as pass.
\item[not\_assessed] The applicable assessment has not been performed or evidence remains unassessed, without substituting for a known blocked dependency.
\item[not\_applicable] The core and exact method permit the absent role, with an explicit applicability premise and reviewer disposition. Missing input/approval is not inapplicability.
\end{description}
An assessment cannot claim overall conformance while applicable requirements
are failed, blocked or unassessed. No required role can be waived by an engineering
summary. Keep the coverage matrix and every failed/unavailable comparison,
including an earlier attempt superseded by a corrected candidate.
Evidence-artifact realization is separately \texttt{realized}, \texttt{incomplete},
\texttt{failed} or \texttt{not\_produced}, with generation/cause/last reached stage.
A realized accounting record may report blocked conformance; a missing evidence
artifact does not become a scientific availability value or automatic pass.

Preregister the observable quantity, units, axes/domain/support, reference/gauge,
comparison population, deterministic or stochastic target, oracle construction,
finite/non-finite policy, numerical profile, comparison statistic and any
tolerance, scale/denominator, sample-size or decision rule required by the
approved method. This ECS selects none of those numerical values. If unavailable,
block that numerical comparison by its exact missing dependency.

Oracle independence means the expected construction does not merely call the
candidate implementation's same path. A symbolic deduction, separately derived
operator calculation or immutable independently constructed record may serve
only within its exact premises. Declare shared assumptions and dependencies.
Use negative controls for missing/incompatible inputs and scope changes;
passing one limiting case never proves general numerical fidelity or coverage.
\ReadCore{REQ-004--006, REQ-021, REQ-023--024.}
}
\Unit{Parent, model transformation and operation evidence}{ecs:bindings}{%
\textbf{EV-001: parent/type/method binding.} Resolve every candidate tuple link
and compare the method record, owner decision, producer route/generation,
grouping and original measured-parent ancestry against an independently built
identity ledger. Check input-rule conversions and all type fields. Negative
fixtures vary one identity/domain/authority at a time. Missing numerical
authority prevents execution-based conformance; do not substitute the family
record. Retain the exact source/build candidate used by each observation.

\textbf{EV-002: accepted-to-applied transformation.} Bind candidate construction,
selection, acceptance and application as distinct records. Observe the actual
operands supplied to removal and rejoin. Independently construct the approved
accepted-to-applied transformation, with normalization/sign/support/unit changes
and the approved dependence rules. Compare objects, domains, supports,
generations and separately addressable transformation uncertainty. Include a
case where accepted and applied differ. Do not silently copy accepted covariance
or error into applied axes. Numerical construction awaits the approved method.

\textbf{EV-003: order/bypass/counts.} Compare the complete ordered realized
operation trace against the independently declared method graph. Check each
path's removal/rejoin locations, every bypassed operation, application count,
owner and state generation. Use fixtures with omitted, repeated or reordered
operations as discriminators; these are prospective fixture designs, not
executed instrumented reductions. An unchanged output alone does not excuse
wrong scientific lineage or a duplicate response application.

\textbf{EV-004: additive compatibility.} Independently enumerate removal and
rejoin operand-pair quantity/unit/scale/frame/grid/domain/support/reference/
gauge/null-space/calibration/response bindings. Check each exact declared
conversion before arithmetic. Include equal-shape but incompatible-gauge or
quantity records. The expected construction is the typed compatibility relation,
not automatic array broadcasting or an inferred offset. Missing facts require
typed unavailability for the affected composition.

For each procedure, emit individual requirement records using the evidence
index. Attach immutable actual/expected records and discrepancy locations.
Do not combine a successful identity check with an unassessed numerical result
under one pass flag.
\ReadCore{REQ-001--007, REQ-010--011, REQ-015.}
}
\Unit{Support, failure, state and limiting-case evidence}{ecs:structure}{%
\textbf{EV-005: support/origin.} Compare all eight roles against independent
path-domain and ancestry constructions, including three separate model-stage
supports and learning influence. The fixture family distinguishes compatible
both-path, permitted residual-only, permitted model-only and unavailable
occurrences. Verify model/prior mode origin independently of those classes.
Include an unavailable upstream absolute mode, so finite rejoin values cannot
be mislabeled acquired exposure or recovered measurement. Preserve exact
producer admission boundaries and absent JINC companion products.

\textbf{EV-006: fail-closed inputs and limiting equations.} Supply prospective
missing/incompatible parent, applied operand, contribution, support or additive
reference fixtures. Expected records name the affected claim/domain/cause and
last reached lifecycle stage; they do not invent zero, identity, bypass or fill.
For numerically approved fixtures, independently substitute the precise
zero-preserving, identity or complete-linear premises into the core equations
(PRED-001--004). Compare each required path contribution as well as final
output. Offsets and missing premises are negative controls. These deductions
define expected constructions; no numerical fixture is instantiated here.

\textbf{EV-007: rule/state/generation identity.} Compare identical-rule changed
realizations and changed-rule scenarios against an independent identity graph.
Check all seven operation/state categories at their exact conditioning scopes,
including fixed structure with recomputed coefficients. Factor mixed operations
rather than hiding their dependencies. Each distinct application/attempt has
its bound states, lineage and parentage. A storage-only representation change
must resolve to the same declared scientific state queries.

For all three procedures, require observables sufficient to assess the named
scientific role. A single final array cannot expose missing support, hidden
learning influence or a silently changed rule. If the candidate cannot expose
or exactly reconstruct required evidence, report the missing observation as
\texttt{blocked} with cause, or \texttt{fail} where an established mandatory
record obligation is violated. Do not infer an underlying implementation
behavior from the missing record alone.
\ReadCore{REQ-005--011, REQ-018, REQ-021, REQ-024.}
}
\Unit{Response evidence with exact fixed and rerun scopes}{ecs:response}{%
\textbf{EV-010.} Register the RF role, perturbation source/domain/units/basis,
baseline, codomain, convention, support/reference/gauge/null-space and branch
comparison. Snapshot all fixed numerical maps, coefficients and other state;
record every prescribed rerun and generation for procedure queries.

For RF-01 perturb only iteration input, hold applied model and every numerical
map/coefficient/state binding fixed, and prove from the trace that no other
consequential binding changed. For RF-02 perturb only applied model, holding
the measured input and the same exact numerical/state bindings fixed. The
independent expected construction is the core fixed-map difference or, with
established differentiability, its chain-rule derivative on the declared
tangent spaces. Under complete fixed linearity, independently reduce to
$A_k,D_k$. No automatic finite-difference step or tolerance is selected here.

For RF-03 rerun every coefficient, construction/selection/acceptance/application,
support and state realization prescribed by the unchanged iteration rule;
verify prior $S_k$ and upstream procedure/state stayed fixed. Fixed-subspace
PTC recomputation and frozen-component subtraction receive different query
records. Any claim that a recomputed procedure realizes RF-01/02 must attach
an exact independent complete-induced-operator proof over the declared domain,
support, centering and state. Equal results in one fixture do not supply it.

RF-04 evidence encloses the exact predeclared fixed sequence/index. RF-05
includes the complete stop/resource/terminal-selector dependence and comparison
population. RF-06 includes every named upstream rerun. RF-07 fixes upstream
producer/state/generation and composes the parent-domain entry and exact
FRUIT-only extent with RF-03/04/05 references. Compare the operation graph
with the declared query boundary; a fixed derivative cannot replace these.

PRED-006/009/010 fixture families distinguish freezing a prescribed rerun,
recomputing a frozen binding, complete-linear reduction and branch/support/gauge
boundary transitions. A derivative absent through failed differentiability or
comparison stays unavailable. A finite-difference/state-transition object is
separately typed, with its own preregistered convention and limitations. Current
numerical response evidence is \texttt{blocked}; its evidence artifacts are not produced.
\ReadCore{ASM-002--005; REQ-006, REQ-012--013; PRED-006, PRED-009--010.}
}
\Unit{Law-relative covariance, shift/bias and NOI evidence}{ecs:uncertainty}{%
\textbf{EV-011.} Register exact target-law identity, random variables, fixed
objects, resolution/selection condition, omitted variation, support/domain and
reference/gauge/null-space state before that law's random event. Use separate
fixtures for physical/random-parent, explicitly fixed-realized-model and
conditional NOI-randomization laws. The first retains random parent/model
values; the second omits model learning and has zero model/cross blocks only
within its narrower law; the third may fix realized parent/model/operator/support
and exact source-law successful design resolution before the NOI member draw.
Do not call them equivalent or reject all resolution conditioning indiscriminately.

FRUIT branch/completion/convergence/terminal-conditioned targets need separate
method and estimand authority and remain blocked here. Check that generation
labels do not hide selection or change the requested law/domain. Independently
expand the exact complete-fixed-linear covariance under its finite-joint-moment
premises; retain both cross terms unless exact law/conditioning authorizes omission.
Transform accepted covariance through the declared application relation and
dependence, keeping transformation uncertainty and all registered roles separate.

For PRED-005 compare the fixed-linear transfer operator $D_k$, model mismatch,
applied-error-induced output shift and law-qualified bias as four distinct
products. Bias needs exact estimand/reference/error-law/conditioning; no expectation
authority means unavailable bias even if the transfer and shift are available.
A deterministic discrepancy or shift is not covariance.

\textbf{EV-012.} Bind iteration/member/ensemble generation, exact target law,
parent/output domains, center convention and exact external NOI-owned product,
source and estimator identity/digest. Missing external bindings are explicitly
unavailable and block numerical comparison. The owner correction supplies the
conditional rule only. With fixed model/state and complete linearity, independently
construct $A_k\delta y_{k,b}^{\mathrm{NOI}}$ for a zero-target-law member and
$A_k y_{k,b}^{\mathrm{full}}+D_k\ma$ for a full parent member with exact center.
Do not add deterministic rejoin to the zero-target-law member.

A discriminator permits nonzero spatial/member sample mean and source/residual
structure while its expectation under the declared law is zero. Require no
finite-ensemble mean subtraction or $B-1$ correction by implication. Full-affine
center/estimator authority, source-law design-resolution conditioning and
response/support parity are exact independent bindings. Preserve distinct
fixed-state, dependent-successor and relearned methods/ensembles and member-state
graphs; no pooling or route admission follows. Every numerical result here is
\texttt{blocked}; evidence-artifact realization is separately recorded.
\ReadCore{REQ-014--016; PRED-005, PRED-011, PRED-018.}
}
\Unit{Continuation, restart, retry and stopping evidence}{ecs:continuation}{%
\textbf{EV-008.} A prospective continuation fixture binds one exact approved
method/profile, immutable base parent, future controls and every causal state
query. Its independent expected relation compares uninterrupted execution with
checkpoint/continuation after completed absolute zero-based iteration $N$.
Continuation must start at $N+1$ from $S_{N+1}$; $N$ is not a count. Compare all
required scientific state/results, support/reference/gauge and stochastic
state under the preregistered numerical equivalence policy, not only the final
array. Record reconstruction and failure behavior for compact/lineage storage.

No method, stopping point, replay budget, numerical profile or tolerance is
selected here. An actual replay requires separate authorized numerical work.
A successful process exit is not evidence of continuation sufficiency. The
fixture's completeness argument must identify all future-consequential facts,
not merely the fields convenient to serialize.

\textbf{EV-009.} Prospective restart cases establish a new lineage and exact
reused ancestry, initialization and counters. Relearning under unchanged rules
produces new realized generations; a rule change creates a new method. Retry
cases retain parent state, randomness/key/counters, attempt identity and earlier
failure. Compare their independent identity graph and scientific state queries.
Request-state fixtures distinguish immutable not-requested/requested generations
and a later new request. Scientific availability and producer outcome are
separate from requested-generation stage order. Early-stop fixtures inspect every reached stage and
prove that no later realized/completed/published success was fabricated. A
separate replacement may reference a failed attempt but cannot erase it.

\textbf{EV-013.} Inspect completion, convergence, resource limit, policy stop,
failure, selection and fitness as separate records. A future convergence
comparison binds its exact proposition, quantity/domain, metric/norm,
scale/denominator, tolerance, direction, persistence/consecutive condition,
missing/non-finite behavior, state and generation. Resource cases compare
counters/accounting and exhaustion consequences independently. PRED-015's
negative control reaches a limit without the convergence premise; the expected
record reports limit/stop only.

These are prospective procedures and expected relations. No continuation,
restart, retry, convergence or resource experiment has been run. Every
numerical entry remains \texttt{blocked}, with its named method/profile,
fixture and comparison dependencies explicit.
\ReadCore{ASM-006; REQ-010, REQ-017--019; PRED-013--015.}
}
\Unit{Comparable selection, completion and immutable publication}{ecs:terminal}{%
\textbf{EV-014.} Bind an exact approved selector method, data access, candidate
population and comparison policy before inspecting outcomes. Independently
construct the common quantity/role, unit/scale, frame/grid/domain, reference/
gauge, response meaning, support comparison domain, method/generation relation
and uncertainty/metric meaning. For cross-route/method/grouping/gauge/support
candidates, retain every selector-owned conversion in its method identity.
Equal-shape and common-scalar incompatible candidates are negative controls.

Compare every candidate's inclusion/exclusion, conversion, ties, unavailable
comparison and cause. Apply only the exact predeclared rule; no latest, final,
lowest-residual or visual preference is implied. Check all nine terminal fields,
including selected completed identity, whole population, rule/generation,
convergence/stop/resource facts, causes, response, uncertainty, continuation/
terminality and only explicitly requested/linked named-use identities/statuses
or a no-request statement. Field 9 is open-world, not a list of every future use. Missing hard comparison/selection
dependencies block the claim. Terminal evidence references the selected bundle
without mutating it and retains RF-05 and any RF-07 composition scope.

\textbf{EV-015.} Compare the candidate's universal and method-required bundle
roles against an independently constructed inventory and their permitted
statuses. Check immutable request state and generation separately from the
requested/effective/resolved/applied/realized/candidate/decision/completed/published
producer path, scientific availability and branch/role outcomes. Verify exact
registered product identities and bundle-bound scientific handoff: bare $z_k$
requires its exact bundle or immutable reference. A complete candidate needs
every required value or allowed typed status; only its exact FRUIT-owned
completion rule establishes completed iteration. Publication exposes the
immutable completed role and generation with provenance.

Use PRED-020 cases for open-world requested/linked child decisions or an
explicit no-request record. Retain SCI-VAL request, applicability, eligibility
and realization separately with exact profile/source. Not-requested creates no
eligibility proposition. Missing profile/unresolved scope may produce a realized
accounting record with applicability\_unknown and decision\_unavailable;
incomplete/failed/not-produced artifacts are different realization conditions.
Generic unavailable is not a SCI-VAL realization value. Check that base
iteration/terminal completion survives missing or failed use and that only an
explicitly requested narrower FRUIT role can require its specified child.
Later children preserve immutable parent bytes/identity without a new iteration.
SCI-VAL does not execute FRUIT or choose model/terminal.\par

Record structural evidence separately from numerical candidate conformance.
This document creates no actual completed numerical iteration, selector,
publication or downstream-admission result.
\ReadCore{REQ-018--022; PRED-016, PRED-020.}
}

\Unit{Source, build and core parity procedure}{ecs:parity}{%
Resolve the exact candidate source tree, build recipe/tool versions and
runtime/environment identity. Rebuild from an isolated copy of the declared
source closure, without inherited build intermediates. Bind produced artifacts
and logs to the candidate tuple. Compare exact core identity and canonical
source-inventory digest with the value authorized for that candidate. A digest
mismatch creates a different or unresolved candidate; it is not silently waived.

For these documents, the canonical core digest is SHA-256 of the exact sorted
source-inventory bytes listing six normative modules and the core body. Each
view has a separate source-inventory digest covering its wrapper/body, common
core modules and shared typography/cover. Generated digest bindings are derived
from those inventories and excluded from their own scopes to avoid self-reference;
the final artifact manifest binds their actual bytes. The identical core binding
is imported into all three covers. Equations used in the rationale invoke the
same canonical macros. The ECS cites their requirement/prediction identity.

The delivered build recipe records exact local Tectonic, cached TeX resources,
Python/document packages and Poppler identities. Its clean build compiles an
isolated declared source closure and compares output identities; the report
states exactly whether bytes or a narrower content comparison agree. Reopen
all PDFs, check metadata titles/owner/revision/date/status, resolve internal
references, render all pages and inspect typography/equations/tables.

Verify gap-free REQ-001--024, ASM-001--006 and PRED-001--020; all product roles,
lifecycle states, support roles, uncertainty distinctions and RF scopes; local
link closure; all source and input hashes; exact archive membership and byte
parity. The exact Stage A archive is a preserved opaque input, not permission
to inspect manager-only science. The immutable historical r0.1 package is
preserved as historical input, not relabeled as r0.2 output.

Document compilation, source parity, PDF rendering and a consistency review
are document verification only. A missing source/digest blocks its dependent
identity/conformance claim with scope and cause; it does not manufacture
numerical authority or invalidate unrelated reproduced sources by implication.
\ReadCore{REQ-001, REQ-010, REQ-023--024.}
}
\Unit{Blank result contract and limits of any future result}{ecs:template}{%
The delivered \texttt{evidence/CONFORMANCE\_RESULT\_TEMPLATE.json} supplies the
following fields with unresolved candidate values and \texttt{blocked}:
\begin{description}
\item[Identity] record identity; evidence generation; requirement ID; candidate tuple and its digest/serialization convention; scientific core/method/owner bindings.
\item[Observation] exact observable; quantity/units/domain/support/reference; actual artifact identities and digests.
\item[Expected construction] immutable fixture identity/digest; independent oracle identity/digest, premises and dependence disclosure.
\item[Comparison] preregistration identity/digest; comparison policy, numerical profile and required missing/non-finite or tolerance rules, left unresolved here.
\item[Disposition] exact five-state result; separately typed evidence-artifact realization; applicability premise; blocking dependency/cause; deviations/failures; reviewer/date; affected claim/scope; superseded evidence parent.
\end{description}
The JSON is a blank evidence-record contract, not an implementation configuration
or selected numerical schema. Nulls are unresolved. Replace them with immutable
approved bindings only in a separately authorized assessment; retain old records
when a new candidate or evidence generation supersedes them.

Keep these claims distinct in any result report:
\begin{description}
\item[Engineering conformance] Evidence for exact applicable core requirements and candidate, with every blocked/unassessed/failing item visible.
\item[Response/representation fidelity] Agreement with its own exact scientific target and approved comparison; not implied by conformance.
\item[Uncertainty coverage] A separate probability/population/coverage proposition and evidence; not inferred from a finite covariance.
\item[Observational validation] Separately authorized observations and tests; no such activity is performed here.
\item[Performance] Measured cost/throughput under an exact workload/environment, not a scientific correctness argument.
\item[Readiness] Its own bounded operational decision; document completeness is not readiness.
\item[Production authorization] Explicit authorized-use decision with its own owner/evidence; none is granted here.
\end{description}
The present numerical disposition is \texttt{blocked}. Evidence-artifact realization
is separately typed; a realized accounting record is not numerical conformance.
No route, implementation conformity, recovered measured mode, convergence
adequacy, Pointing/OOF/catalogue fitness, production suitability/authorization
or Unity activity is claimed. Independent consistency review remains advisory;
Grant Wilson's possible conditional scientific freeze is a separate decision.
}
